title: packages: 73 published root packages carry inconsistent publishing metadata — 18 without README, about 13 without LICENSE, about 33 with main on the ESM file and one types entry for both formats, 19 without publishConfig, sideEffects only in spec
body:
Filing gate ③: a maintainer-directed task. Maintainer, 2026-10-26, verbatim: 「完整的评估本项目， 还有哪些可以优化的地方。包括 ci 和文档」 then 「使用 pm-dispatch 技能创建 issue，需要决策的立为决策卡。」 and 「低优先级的先不考虑」. Batch-of: 19 (repository evaluation 2026-10-26, `session_019a9XCWsbMFp75REzthE6cs`; 9 decision cards + 10 execution cards). ⛔ Filed bare: grading, `domain:*` and `area:*` are triage's. ⛔ Not a claim. Reader: the `domain:server` or `domain:devx` execution seat (the files are per-package manifests; triage decides) — one os-dev, one or two PRs. Dedupe: REST list (439 issues), grep `sideEffects|publint|attw|LICENSE|README` → #25913 (open, pm:queue, `domain:ui`: "30 of 39 published packages declare no sideEffects" — the ui tree). This card is the root tree's 73 non-private manifests; same `sideEffects` mechanism, different tree, plus the README / LICENSE / exports items #25913 does not cover. **New for the root tree.**

**谁付代价（业务筛）:** a consumer who installs `@objectstack/<pkg>` and opens it on npm sees no README for 18 of them; a CJS consumer resolves `main` to an ESM file; TypeScript under `moduleResolution: node16` sees one `.d.ts` for both module formats (arethetypeswrong's "masquerading as ESM/CJS"); bundlers cannot tree-shake 60 packages that never said `sideEffects`.

## Measured (HEAD 0d83ee8f77; manifest census over `packages/**/package.json`, `private !== true` → 73)

- `sideEffects`: set only in `@objectstack/spec`; about 60 other published packages lack it (`grep -l sideEffects packages/*/package.json packages/*/*/package.json` → 1).
- No README: `apps/account`, `apps/setup`, `apps/studio`, `connector-mcp`, `connector-openapi`, `connector-rest`, `connector-slack`, `platform-objects`, `plugin-approvals`, `plugin-email`, `plugin-pinyin-search`, `plugin-sharing`, `plugin-webhooks`, `sdui-parser`, `service-cluster`, `service-messaging`, `service-sms`, `trigger-api` (18).
- No LICENSE file: about 13 published packages, e.g. `lint`, `metadata-protocol`, `verify`, `service-datasource`, the `trigger-*` packages (the dev lists them; `files` may or may not include a root LICENSE copy at publish time — read `scripts/` release tooling first).
- About 33 packages: `"main": "dist/index.js"` (ESM) while `exports.require` is `./dist/index.cjs`; one `types` entry for both conditions. `spec`: `types: dist/index.d.ts` while its `exports` use `.d.mts`.
- 19 published packages have no `publishConfig`.
- Packages with no tests at all: `apps/account`, `apps/setup`, `apps/studio`, `qa/refd-timer-testkit` (console and skills have no source) — listed, not actioned here.

## Wanted

1. Run `publint` and `@arethetypeswrong/cli` once over the 73 built packages (a one-time reading, ⛔ no new gate on this card — if the maintainer wants one it is a decision); paste the summary in the PR.
2. Fix what they report: `main`/`exports`/`types` per format (`.d.ts` + `.d.cts` or the `types` condition inside `exports`), consistent `publishConfig`, a README for each of the 18 (one paragraph: what it is, the one import, a link to the docs page), LICENSE where the release tooling does not already inject it.
3. `sideEffects`: declare per package after reading each entry — `false` for pure libraries, an array for packages that register on import (the same reading #25913 prescribes for ui). ⛔ Not a blanket `false`.
4. ⛔ Nothing here changes a metadata contract or a public API; a package whose exports map has to change shape to satisfy attw gets its own card.

## Acceptance

- publint and attw clean (or every remaining warning explained in the PR body) on the 73; `check:readme-exports` and the publish-smoke lane green; the next `pack-smoke-optin` run passes.

**Size:** M. **Clause-②:** no. **Metadata-protocol:** none.

## Related

#25913 (open, ui tree), #25764 (open: dist-tag sweep), `publish-smoke.yml`, `pack-smoke-optin.yml`.
